project.description: HTTP probe of localhost:8080/roi-shiraz-omri-noa-arbel-app/ every 5 minutes. Build green = app UP.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: set -e URL="http://localhost:8080/roi-shiraz-omri-noa-arbel-app/" CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 10 "$URL") TIME=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}" --max-time 10 "$URL") echo "Probed $URL" echo "HTTP $CODE in ${TIME}s" if [ "$CODE" != "200" ]; then echo "DOWN: expected HTTP 200, got $CODE" exit 1 fi echo "UP"
